Attached: 1 video

Chroma agentic memory is not “save every conversation.” 

It is a disciplined loop for retrieving and writing the few records that change a later decision.

A persistent collection can stop an agent from repeating research, re-asking a preference, or rediscovering a working tactic. But storage alone does not decide what is trustworthy, who a memory belongs to, or when it should expire.

#Chroma #AIAgents #AgentEngineering #VectorDatabase
